items.html: And with this you will understand the existence of the seven kings under every aspect: in Bina, and in ZA, and in Malchut, and at the end of each of them, in their three lower ones, in the posterior sides, for this is called 'under.' And in the Malchut of Assiyah, Nefashot, and in Yetzirah, Ruchin, etc. And from elsewhere you will understand what is said above, that the upper Klipa of Atzilut is called the purity of Beriah, for the purity of Beriah is called the impurity of Atzilut.
